brain: Arduino Ventuno Q (Qualcomm Dragonwing IQ8 + STM32H5) — the system runs here; the PuppyPi itself is not driven by it

control.label: dream only — the system cannot control this robot, so it dreams about it and trains it virtually

files.detector: system/detect.pte — 'which robot is this?' (puppy vs other), trained from photos via system/vision_ingest.py + system/detect_train.py
files.photos: about/src-photo-side.jpg, about/src-photo-front.jpg (the real robot, at the event)

host_robot: Hiwonder PuppyPi (Raspberry Pi 5, 8 GB) — a robot dog from another team at the event

learned.detector: trained from photos of the real robot (upload → augment → on-board training)

plugs.act: none — dream-only project: no control channel to this robot
plugs.see: USB webcam on the Ventuno Q (/dev/video0)
plugs.think: Ventuno Q Linux — ExecuTorch runtime, PyTorch training

status: THE robot under test at the ExecuTorch Hackathon (Oct 18, 2026): watched by the camera, dreamed about on the dream stage, trained virtually
